name: PokeFlex
summary: 面向可变形物体机器人操作的真实世界试验数据集，通过机器人戳动采集完整 360 度三维网格形变及对应力和力矩。
summaryEn: A real-world pilot dataset for deformable-object manipulation, capturing complete 360-degree 3D mesh deformations together with robot-applied forces and torques during poking.
scale: Five deformable objects spanning different shapes and stiffness levels
scaleZh: 5 个具有不同形状和刚度的可变形物体
organizationsZh: 斯图加特大学及合作团队
license: Dataset license not confirmed from the official project entry
licenseZh: 官方项目入口未确认数据许可
access: Official project page and reconstruction code available
accessZh: 提供官方项目页和重建代码
verdict: 带力反馈的三维形变数据
wmNote: 同步动作、力矩和完整形变几何非常适合可变形动力学建模，但试验对象数量较少。
wmNoteEn: Synchronized actions, forces, and full deformation geometry directly support deformable dynamics modeling, though only a few objects are included.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2409.17124] PokeFlex: Towards a Real-World Dataset of Deformable Objects for Robotic Manipulation
evidence.statement: Robot poking pairs actively deformed 3D meshes with applied forces and torques.
